page_title: CRY 4-2 WOL | Crystal Palace v Wolves 20/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Daniel Bentley stops the ball from going inside right post.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

90+5' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
86' 4 - 2 Wonderful finish from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace). He drills a low shot precisely into the bottom left corner. No chance for the goalkeeper.
85' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) takes the corner with a short pass.
84' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
82' Wolves fail to score from a corner as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaps to collect the ball.
82' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
81' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) replacing Rodrigo Gomes.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Romain Esse as he is replaced by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
81' Substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) in, Eddie Nketiah out.
81' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Wolves win a corner.
78' The goalkeeper dives to deny Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
77' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

77' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top right corner, but Dean Henderson keeps it out with an amazing save. Wolves will take a corner kick.
76' David Webb blows his whistle and signals a foul after Romain Esse (Crystal Palace) brought his opponent down.
74' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
73' It's a nice effort by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Daniel Bentley. Easy save.
71' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Joel Ward will be replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
69' The foul by Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by David Webb.
68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' It will be a substitution. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as Pablo Sarabia walks off.
67' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Marshall Munetsi (Wolves).
63' Substitution. Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ismaila Sarr walks off.

62' 3 - 2 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 3:2.
62' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
62' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
61' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Toti (Wolves) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
56' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) whips the ball into the box and Jorgen Strand Larsen takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
56' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and David Webb blows his whistle for an infringement.
53' The referee blows his whistle as Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in his challenge.
53' Romain Esse (Crystal Palace) passes the ball onto Eddie Nketiah, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
52' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left David Webb no option but to blow his whistle.
50' 3 - 1 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Daniel Bentley stranded. 3:1.
49' The free kick will be taken by Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace).

48' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Webb blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Crystal Palace.
46' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nelson Semedo comes on the pitch for Nasser Djiga (Wolves).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Andre comes off for Joao Gomes (Wolves).
46' Oliver Glasner makes a half-time substitution. Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) comes on in place of Will Hughes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) takes it short.
45+3' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. Wolves get a corner.

45+3' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
44' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) fails to beat a perfect example of the offside trap.
43' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
41' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
36' David Webb has a clear sight and sees a foul from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
32' 2 - 1 Goal! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) scores after an assist by Ismaila Sarr that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:1.
30' The foul by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was seen by David Webb who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Romain Esse provided an assist for the goal.
26' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Daniel Bentley is alert and denies him.
24' 0 - 1 Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
24' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

23' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
22' David Webb shows a yellow card to Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
21' Some neat passing and movement from Wolves as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
19' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
19' Toti (Wolves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
17' Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Daniel Bentley makes a smart save to deny him.
14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) trips an opposition player and David Webb signals a foul.
12' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
9' A cross into the box from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is cleared.
8' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

5' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went wide of the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
4' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' David Webb blows his whistle after Andre (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
2' Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
1' Wolves players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
David Webb will referee today's match.
